description: IC-LoRA that turns a 3D viewport playblast - clay render or blocky shapes from Blender or Unreal - into a finished shot, keeping the camera move and object placement. The playblast is the reference video and a styled first-frame image (art direction, not the raw clay frame) is a keyframe condition. One or two sentences describing the finished shot; never mention clay, 3D or the tool. 960x544 stage 1, 1920x1088 stage 2, 24 fps; width and height divisible by 64
use_when: Render a 3D blockout or previs animation as a finished shot
